ModulInfo.Title: System Information
ModulInfo.SettingsDesc: Backup or restore your extension data to your computer.

ModerationInfo.Title: Moderation
ModerationInfo.Item1: Moderation tools work in channels where you are a moderator or in your own channel.
ModerationInfo.Item2: While ban, timeout, and cross-ban settings are active in other channels, only the cross-ban setting is active in your own channel.
ModerationInfo.Item3: You must follow the channels where you are a moderator when applying a cross-ban.
ModerationInfo.Item4: While you cannot ban or timeout users who are moderators in your own channel, you can apply a cross-ban in other channels you follow and moderate, provided the user is not a moderator there.
ModerationInfo.Item5: The timeout duration cannot exceed 1 week.

StreamerModeSettings.Title: Streamer Mode
StreamerModeSettings.Item1: If streamer mode is active, you can view your own chat messages or take actions in certain windows for your own channel.
StreamerModeSettings.Item2: Advanced Moderation Mode activates the advanced moderation panel, which offers cross-bans, custom timeout durations, and detailed chat history, replacing Kick's default panel on user profiles.

LiveNotificationSettings.Title: Live Notification Settings
LiveNotificationSettings.Item1: You receive live broadcast notifications for the channels you follow.
LiveNotificationSettings.Item2: You can choose to receive either sound or visual notifications.
LiveNotificationSettings.Item3: You must be logged in to use this feature.
